blocks.explanation:
Table istemaal nahi karna; chaabi yeh hai ke \(64^{\circ} = 45^{\circ} + 19^{\circ}\).
Upar neeche \(\cos 19^{\circ}\) se divide karein to left side tangent of sum ki shakal le leta hai.
Plan: \(\cos 19^{\circ}\) se divide, 1 ko \(\tan 45^{\circ}\) likhna, phir \(\tan(\alpha + \beta)\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: ek identity.
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \tan 64^{\circ}\).
Tareeqa:
\[\tan(\alpha + \beta) = \dfrac{\tan\alpha + \tan\beta}{1 - \tan\alpha\tan\beta}\]
jahan \(\alpha = 45^{\circ}\), \(\beta = 19^{\circ}\), aur \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\). Jab bhi \(\frac{1 + \tan x}{1 - \tan x}\) jaisi shakal dikhe, foran \(\tan(45^{\circ} + x)\) yaad aana chahiye.

Upar neeche \(\cos 19^{\circ}\) se divide karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1 + \tan 19^{\circ}}{1 - \tan 19^{\circ}}\]
Kyun: Har term ko \(\cos 19^{\circ}\) se divide kiya: \(\frac{\cos 19^{\circ}}{\cos 19^{\circ}} = 1\) aur \(\frac{\sin 19^{\circ}}{\cos 19^{\circ}} = \tan 19^{\circ}\). Upar neeche ek hi cheez se divide karne se value nahi badalti.

1 ko \(\tan 45^{\circ}\) likhein
\[= \dfrac{\tan 45^{\circ} + \tan 19^{\circ}}{1 - \tan 45^{\circ}\tan 19^{\circ}}\]
Kyun: \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\), is liye yeh badalna jaiz hai. Is se tangent sum ka formula saaf nazar aane lagta hai. Neeche wala 1 formula ka apna 1 hai, usay nahi badalna.

Formula lagayein
\[= \tan(45^{\circ} + 19^{\circ}) = \tan 64^{\circ} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Expanded shakal ko wapas compact shakal mein likh diya.
Dhyan dein: Students aksar \(\cos 19^{\circ} + \sin 19^{\circ}\) ko seedha kisi angle ka sine samajh lete hain; pehle tangent banana zaroori hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{0.9455 + 0.3256}{0.9455 - 0.3256} = \dfrac{1.2711}{0.6199}\]
\[\approx 2.050\]
\[\tan 64^{\circ} \approx 2.050 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Calculator se dono sides ek jaisi aayin.
